out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Plan & Specifications Submission - Remodeling, Change of Type, Change of Operation
violations.observation: The permit holder did not submit plans or specifications for remodeling/renovation, change in type of establishment leading to extensive menu change, and/or change in layout/equipment. Observed addition of new fryer, grill, and rice cooker to establishment without submission of an amendment on PLUS.
violations.corrective_action: The permit applicant needs to submit the following documents to the Health Department for review and approval: equipment specifications, layout, and menu. Please submit an amendment on PLUS within 10 days.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: observed equipment in dish machine with 0 ppm of chlorine.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. PIC washed, rinsed, and sanitized equipment at 3 compartment sink.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: observed dish machine with 0 ppm of chlorine.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PIC submitted service request during visit. Please submit invoice and photo of test strip with appropriate chlorine concentration to EHS within 10 days.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: pinto beans (100F), black beans (97F) on range.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC reheated beans to above 165F.
